The kobuki base Battery status publishes keys 'Capacity', 'Voltage', 'Percent', 'Source', 'State' with no units, while the laptop battery status in the same package (same 'Power System' aggregator group) uses unit-suffixed keys 'Voltage (V)', 'Charge (Ah)', 'Capacity (Ah)'; a consumer reading /diagnostics_agg by status name and key would likely not find the keys it expects for the base battery. This also draws on general familiarity with TurtleBot dashboard key conventions, not on any consulted source.
